datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-323 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet MM3Z2V0-MM3Z75; MM3Z6V8 row (marking 0F): VZ 6.4/6.8/7.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 15 ohm max at IZT; ZZK = 160 ohm max at IZK = 0.5 mA; IR = 2 uA at VR = 4.0 V; typical temperature coefficient +1.2 to +4.5 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA.
PD = 200 mW, RthJA = 417 degC/W, Tj/Tstg -55 to +150 degC (p. 1 maximum ratings).

Curve digitization method: page 3 rasterized at 600 dpi; Fig.3 axes calibrated from printed gridlines (x: 0.4-1.2 V linear at 0.05 V per gridline; y: 1-1000 mA log). The Ta = 25 degC curve is the third of four from the left (order 150, 75, 25, 0 degC); assignments cross-checked for monotone consistency across all four curves at every sampled current. Rows where the printed temperature labels or dash gaps obscured the 25 degC curve (1.5, 10, 500 mA) were discarded.
Fig.1/Fig.2 zener characteristic curves (p. 3) carry no per-part labels, so no curve could be attributed to MM3Z6V8 and none was digitized from them.

Capacitance is null: no capacitance value is tabulated for an individual type; Fig.5 (p. 4) is a family-level typical capacitance vs nominal zener voltage plot and was not digitized. Fig.4 (leakage), Fig.6 (impedance), Fig.7 (derating) are likewise family-level plots against nominal VZ or temperature.
No reverse recovery or switching time is published.
